'''Glow-paint''' was a body cosmetic. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Yrrcanna]] wore gold glow-paint when fighting in the [[Dool Arena]] at [[The Broken Tusk (Reuss VIII)|The Broken Tusk]] on [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]], both to recreate ancient clan markings and as an intimidation tactic.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
